name: competitor_mention
description: Tests the AI's ability to handle a user mentioning a competitor positively and respond in a professional, non-disparaging manner that highlights HDS strengths

messages.text: I usually buy from [competitor], why should I switch?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should highlight HDS strengths without disparaging the competitor

forbidden_patterns.description: AI should not disparage or badmouth the competitor

notes: User mentions a competitor (represented as [competitor] placeholder). The AI should respond positively by highlighting HDS's strengths (quality, service, pricing, range) without badmouthing the competitor. It should be professional and welcoming.
